title: A Joomla site's webroot is the web user's again after the provision steps that run PHP as root; tracy-host's identity and derive passes run as the web user
steps: S1: Read provision.sh's commands (comments left out) for own_webroot, platform_post_up and build_webroot_baseline.
S2: Read tracy-host's JOOMLA_EXEC and JOOMLA_DERIVE_EXEC.
expect: S1: own_webroot runs once before the doors are installed and once between platform_post_up and the baseline.
S2: both exec into the site's web container with -u www-data.
evidence: 16/10/2026 local stand: the first page view after a Joomla build answered 500 "Folder::create: Could not create directory … administrator/cache/t4core"; joomla.sh runs joomla-contract-install.php and joomla-template-activate.php as root after the step-6 chown, and the Cowork plugin's own note says administrator/cache is a folder the web user cannot write
fence: Static order of provision steps and the exec user; the Mac stand maps every owner to root, so the Linux effect is checked by the order, not by a page view

tests: the webroot goes back to the web user after the post-up hook
runs once per site: WordPress and Joomla are set up
